coordinate_system: Three X east/Y up/Z south, metres. Local asset X follows row; local +Z is row right.
root_y_semantics: Each instance root is sampled on the exact terrain triangle at its final laterally offset X/Z. It is NOT placed on top of the coarse hedge. Centerline point Y is terrain height.
source: Original authored tea rows in assets/highlands/tea_rows.json; clipped only for detail, not changing any existing mesh.

recommended.coarse_fade_note: Keep coarse hedge unless a complete dense near coverage region is admitted. Use coverage_radius_m returned by the reference selector, with a feather/dither transition inside it; outside stays unchanged. Near/far must not both disappear at the instance cap.
